description_detailed: Founded in 1923 by Walt Disney, Disney Animation studio’s are celebrating 100 years of stories and magic. Historically established as “Disney Brothers Studios”, the American studio has produced more than 150 films and hundreds of animated shorts since its creation. The characters created by the studio's animators have crossed time and generations, continuing to amaze adults and children alike. This miniset celebrates the 100th anniversary of Disney Studios. It contains all 8 French circulating denominations in Brilliant uncirculated (BU) quality. The €1 coin is minted exclusively for Miniset and proof quality series and will not be minted in circulating quality in 2023.
